Introduction. Greylings are aggressive creatures found in Meadows. They are mossy tree-like beings and are substantially weaker than their Greydwarf counterparts.

Attack. Swings their hand sideways in a 1.5-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (5 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

Notes. • Along with Necks and Boars, Greylings are one of the first enemies the player may encounter in Valheim.
• 1-star and 2-star Greylings can only be spawned in using commands, and take on the appearance of the 1-star and 2-star Greydwarfs.
